title: containers.json
description: Who may change which part of a site or docs repository (agents/containers.ts). Every section is a container with one owner that writes its copy and one builder, its function's IT specialist, that builds it. The design system has one owner. containers.ts checks the rules a schema cannot: unique ids, a builder that is <function>-it, an owner that is not the builder, holds that name containers, and paths that one container claims.

paths.description: Globs from the repository root: * within a folder, ** across folders.

owner.description: The agent that writes the copy: a capability, category or function agent.

category.description: The category agent with authority over the owner.

builder.description: <function>-it, the one agent that builds it.

holds.description: For a page: the containers it holds, in order.
